seasons.name: Stagione 1
seasons.plot: Ahsoka Tano, the former Padawan of Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars, investigates a mysterious new threat to the galaxy after the fall of the Empire. As she reunites with her former apprentice, Sabine Wren, rumors of the villainous Thrawn's return are on the rise.
